text.p: Cleanup continues along the Red River in the upper Plains of the USA and in southern Manitoba, Canada, near Winnepeg. The next chance for moderate rain in the area does not come until late in the week. Rainfall so far this month has averaged below normal.

Tropical cyclone 36s (Rhonda) is a significant risk to shipping in the southeast Indian Ocean. Top winds have reached 115 mph in the latest report with the system near 18s/99e. This system is expected to become extratropical as it tracks towards the southwest coast of Australia. It may reach this coast this weekend.
There are no further statements at this time.
